title: Spotlight New England: A paranormal investigator's latest projects
excerpt: Amy Bruni, a paranormal investigator and author, appeared on this edition of Spotlight New England.
content:
EAST PROVIDENCE, R.I. (WPRI) — Amy Bruni, a paranormal investigator and author, appeared on this edition of Spotlight New England.

In the video above, Bruni shares more details with hosts Ashley Erling and Audrey McClelland on the release of her second cookbook, "Cuisine to Kill For."

Follow Ashley and Audrey on social media: @ashleyaudreydaily
